$schema_note: Cloudflare Custom Rules + Rate Limiting for LVL Store (/shop), store APIs (/api/store/*), and multi-rail pay (/pay). Apply with: RULE_PACK=shop-pay node scripts/apply-cloudflare-waf.mjs — or paste into Dashboard → Security → WAF / Rate limiting rules.
description: LVL Store + Pay edge WAF / DDoS companion (human + agent traffic)

notes: Do not challenge legitimate multi-rail redirects harshly on /pay POST if payment providers POST back without JS.
Prefer managed_challenge over hard block on shop browse for high threat_score.
Agent catalog JSON should stay GET-friendly; rate-limit, don't bot-block aggressively.
Static mockups resolved to S3: L7 rules here do not apply to pfy-prod-automaton-cache.s3 — only factory host.

rules.description: Shop: allow only safe HTTP methods on /shop
rules.expression: (http.host eq "factory.lvlltd.com" and starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/shop") and not http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD" "OPTIONS"})
rules.note: Storefront is read-only at the edge; cart is client-side. Blocks odd verbs used in scanners.

rules.description: Shop: managed challenge high threat scores on /shop
rules.expression: (http.host eq "factory.lvlltd.com" and starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/shop") and cf.threat_score gt 25)
rules.note: Browsers can solve challenges. Raise threshold to 40 if false positives.

rules.description: Shop: challenge empty or scripted User-Agents on product paths
rules.expression: (http.host eq "factory.lvlltd.com" and starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/shop") and http.request.method eq "GET" and (not len(http.user_agent) gt 0 or http.user_agent contains "sqlmap" or http.user_agent contains "nikto" or http.user_agent contains "masscan"))
rules.note: Light UA filter; real bots for SEO may need allowlist later.

rules.expression: (http.host eq "factory.lvlltd.com" and starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/store/") and not http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD" "OPTIONS" "POST"})

rules.description: Store API: block POST bodies > 64KB on /api/store/*
rules.expression: (http.host eq "factory.lvlltd.com" and starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/store/") and http.request.method eq "POST" and http.request.body.size gt 65536)
rules.note: Warm/image admin POSTs stay small; raise if you add bulk warm endpoints.

rules.description: Store API: challenge high threat on non-essential store paths
rules.expression: (http.host eq "factory.lvlltd.com" and starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/store/") and cf.threat_score gt 40 and not http.request.uri.path eq "/api/store/catalog")
(http.host eq "factory.lvlltd.com" and http.request.uri.path eq "/api/store/image" and not http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD" "OPTIONS"})
(http.host eq "factory.lvlltd.com" and starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/pay") and not http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD" "POST" "OPTIONS"})
(http.host eq "factory.lvlltd.com" and starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/pay") and http.request.method eq "POST" and http.request.body.size gt 262144)

rules.description: Pay: managed challenge high threat on GET /pay (not POST callbacks)
rules.expression: (http.host eq "factory.lvlltd.com" and starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/pay") and http.request.method eq "GET" and cf.threat_score gt 30)
rules.note: POST left unchallenged for payment provider / wallet return paths.

rules.description: Pay: skip Bot Fight products on POST /pay (provider callbacks)
rules.expression: (http.host eq "factory.lvlltd.com" and starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/pay") and http.request.method eq "POST")
rules.note: Does NOT skip rateLimit — payment POST still rate-limited below.

rules.description: Agent UI: challenge high threat on /agent/* browse
rules.expression: (http.host eq "factory.lvlltd.com" and starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/agent/") and cf.threat_score gt 50 and http.request.method eq "GET")
rules.note: Higher threshold so headless agents with normal scores still pass.

rate_limiting_rules.expression: (http.host eq "factory.lvlltd.com" and starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/shop") and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"})
rate_limiting_rules.note: Generous for humans; stops crude scrapers. Use managed_challenge action if plan supports.

rate_limiting_rules.description: Store API: 120 GET/min per IP on /api/store/catalog
rate_limiting_rules.expression: (http.host eq "factory.lvlltd.com" and http.request.uri.path eq "/api/store/catalog" and http.request.method eq "GET")

rate_limiting_rules.description: Image proxy: 240 GET/min per IP on /api/store/image
rate_limiting_rules.expression: (http.host eq "factory.lvlltd.com" and http.request.uri.path eq "/api/store/image" and http.request.method eq "GET")
rate_limiting_rules.note: Product grids ~6–12 images; 240/min leaves headroom. Prefer CDN cache so this rarely fires.

rate_limiting_rules.description: Store API: 60 req/min per IP on other /api/store/*
rate_limiting_rules.expression: (http.host eq "factory.lvlltd.com" and starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/store/") and not http.request.uri.path eq "/api/store/catalog" and not http.request.uri.path eq "/api/store/image")
(http.host eq "factory.lvlltd.com" and starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/pay") and http.request.method eq "GET")
(http.host eq "factory.lvlltd.com" and starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/pay") and http.request.method eq "POST")
rate_limiting_rules.note: Tight against carding / settle spam; raise if legitimate multi-rail retries need more.

rate_limiting_rules.expression: (http.host eq "factory.lvlltd.com" and starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/agent/") and http.request.method eq "GET")

under_attack_mode.recommendation: If Under Attack Mode is enabled zone-wide, add skips or path exceptions for /api/printify/webhooks POST and carefully test /pay POST callbacks.
exclude_paths_from_challenge: /pay (POST only — prefer custom rule skip over global UAM)

dashboard_checklist: Security → Settings: Bot Fight Mode on; ensure webhook/pay POST skips remain
Security → WAF → Custom rules: import rules with [lvl-shop-|lvl-store-|lvl-pay-|lvl-agent-] ids
Security → WAF → Rate limiting rules: import rate_limiting_rules
Caching: Cache Rules for /shop static assets if not already; API paths bypass cache
Notifications: enable DDoS / WAF alerts to ops email
Do not grey-cloud origin; do not publish *.vercel.app in public docs
